claims: Apple TV+ has officially renewed Shrinking for a fourth season.
There was an initial plan to end Shrinking after three seasons.
Shrinking is created by Jason Segel, Brett Goldstein, and Bill Lawrence.
The renewal for Season 4 was announced around the Season 3 premiere in January 2026.
Season 3 of Shrinking premiered in January 2026.
Season 3 of Shrinking concludes in April 2026.
In Season 3 of Shrinking, Jimmy played by Jason Segel navigates life after grief and forgiveness.
In Season 3 of Shrinking, Paul played by Harrison Ford deals with Parkinson's.
Jason Segel, Brett Goldstein, and Bill Lawrence confirmed they would continue creating new stories as long as Apple TV+ wants more.
Cast members took part in a press day to discuss the renewal.
Shrinking has broken its original three-season plan
